summary: Uttarakhand State Government – Uniformed Group C
intro: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released Advertisement No. 84/UKSSSC/2026 for 1,694 uniformed Group C posts including District Police Constable, PAC/IRB Constable, Fireman, Forest Guard (Van Arakshi), Special Tiger Guard and Jail Warder.
Candidates who have passed 12th (Intermediate) can apply online on the UKSSSC website from 25 November 2026 to 25 December 2026. Full details of fee, age, dates and selection process are given below.
table: Police Constable, PAC/IRB, Fireman, Forest Guard, Special Tiger Guard, Jail Warder & others
Post-wise; approx. 18–25 years for Constable (as on 01.07.2026)

p: A total of 1,694 posts have been notified across 11 uniformed posts. Some of the confirmed figures:
table: District Police Constable, PAC/IRB, Jail Warder & others
after: Post-wise and category-wise (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS) vacancies are given in the official advertisement on sssc.uk.gov.in.

ul: 12th (Intermediate) or equivalent from a recognised Board.
For Forest Guard: Intermediate from a Board/Council established by law in India.
Police, PAC and Fireman posts also require prescribed height and chest standards (see advertisement).

p: Age is calculated as on 01 July 2026. For Constable posts, candidates born between 02 July 2001 and 01 July 2008 are eligible (about 18–25 years). Age limits differ for some posts.
after: Reservation and age relaxation are available only to Uttarakhand domicile candidates as per state rules.
Payment mode: Online (Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI).

table: Last Date to Apply & Pay Fee

ul: Physical Standard Test / Physical Efficiency Test (for uniformed posts)

sections.h: How to Apply for UKSSSC Constable 2026
ol: Open Advertisement No. 84/UKSSSC/2026 and read it fully.
Register and fill the online form, choosing your post preferences.
Pay the fee online and submit.

faq: How many posts are in UKSSSC Constable Recruitment 2026?
A total of 1,694 posts including Police Constable, PAC, Fireman, Forest Guard, Special Tiger Guard and Jail Warder.
What is the last date for UKSSSC Constable 2026?
25 December 2026. The correction window is 28–30 December 2026.
What is the qualification for UKSSSC Constable?
What is the UKSSSC Constable 2026 fee?
₹300 for General/OBC and ₹150 for SC/ST/EWS/PwD candidates.
What is the age limit for UKSSSC Police Constable 2026?
Candidates born between 02.07.2001 and 01.07.2008 are eligible (about 18–25 years) as on 01.07.2026.
Can candidates from other states apply?
Yes, but reservation and age relaxation benefits are only for Uttarakhand domicile candidates.
final: UKSSSC Constable Recruitment 2026 is a big opportunity for 12th pass candidates who want a uniformed job in Uttarakhand. Start your physical preparation along with the written exam and apply before 25 December 2026.
Follow @employmentjunction.in on Instagram for the UKSSSC exam date, admit card and result.
